turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I wake up drenched in sweat most nights. The room isn't even that warm.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That can come from bedding that traps heat, alcohol, spicy food late, or sometimes medication or hormone changes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The game just asked me to name my village and I've been staring at the box for five minutes.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Naming things is hard! Do you want something funny you'll laugh at every time, or something grand and epic?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pause there and let me talk to my cousin. I'll be the one to pick it up again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: If we want Sunday free, we need to get the chores done tomorrow.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Washing, bathroom, food shop. Which one do you want?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I'll do the food shop. You're terrible at it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How am I terrible at it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: You came back with four kinds of crisps and no milk.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That was one time. Fine, I'll do the bathroom.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Omar, do you mind if I put the news on?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Go for it, just keep it low.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, sorry, I'm back with you. Continue.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Your village still needs a name. Funny or epic?
